intro: Verdan the Everliving is a colossal bog beast lurking deep within the verdant tunnels of the Wailing Caverns. He dwells amid the nightmare spreading from the sleeping druid Naralex, alongside the corrupted Druids of the Fang, and violently attacks any who venture into his damp hollows.

p: Verdan is a hulking bog beast, an elemental of foliage, silt, and mire that lurks in the overgrown depths of the Wailing Caverns. Nothing is known of him from before the caverns fell to corruption; he is simply the largest and most dangerous creature in their lush, flooded hollows.
